glyph_policy.rule: Inspect each nonprinting C0, replacement character and private-use glyph on both sides; map only the eight bound L021 occurrences visually confirmed on source physical8. Preserve each visible matrix delimiter as one literal parenthesis. Reject all other unclassified glyphs. Ordinary whitespace is treated equally. No source PDF is altered or redistributed.
glyph_policy.sensitivity: Report raw and calibrated five metrics under both NFC and NFKC. Never delete the controls. Keep raw full-document furniture sensitivity separately.
glyph_policy.expected_invariance: Each substituted C0 and its ASCII parenthesis are one UTF-8 byte, one nonspace nonalphanumeric character and not normalized by NFC/NFKC; hence these substitutions should preserve all five metrics. This is checked, not assumed.

cost_rules.shared: Pay full U_E and full phase230 finite program once inside this topic. Add complete A1, A2, A3 and complete two new GAP files. No cross-topic discount.
cost_rules.external: Condition on the explicitly unioned retained library shown above, available symmetrically to source and replacement. Costs are unknown, not zero. New classical torus/Giudici/Dirichlet/Suzuki edges remain visible.
cost_rules.historical_program: Supporting historical program costs remain unknown. The manuscript-plus-our-code ratio is a known-cost coordinate, not an exact all-artifact factor.
cost_rules.reported_factors: Exact written-text factor under stated representation and retained-library convention; source manuscript text divided by our text plus required code is a explicitly labelled known-cost coordinate, not an exact all-artifact ratio. Do not claim total proof-cost or minimum complexity.
cost_rules.optional_verification: Lean and review/render/replay infrastructure inventoried separately; partial Lean verification is not a full proof.
cost_rules.third_programs: Both current phase258 programs contain diagnostics and explicit correction witnesses. Charge every line, comment and control. A future smaller core requires separate reviewed refactoring.
